sql: WITH total_pago_2024 AS (SELECT SUM(CAST(vlr_pag_fonte AS DECIMAL)) AS total_pago FROM despesa_pagamento WHERE ano_referencia = 2024), total_pago_2025 AS (SELECT SUM(CAST(vlr_pag_fonte AS DECIMAL)) AS total_pago FROM despesa_pagamento WHERE ano_referencia = 2025) SELECT (SELECT total_pago FROM total_pago_2024) AS total_pago_2024, (SELECT total_pago FROM total_pago_2025) AS total_pago_2025;
